text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed the feasibility and is recommending the installation of speed bumps in the public lane west of Ossington Avenue, south of Dupont Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed bumps in the public lane west of Ossington Avenue, between Dupont Street and Hallam Street, as shown in Attachment 1, Drawing TC-138 dated April 2023, to the report (May 5, 2023) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services.
